Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 32

“Many kinds of sacrifice are thus spread out before Brahman. Know them all to be born of action; knowing this, you will be liberated.”

Krishna reveals the point of the whole catalogue. Every practice he listed is a form of doing, which means the path Arjuna wanted to escape runs straight through all of them.
